prompt_en: A schoolgirl in a white ao dai walks her bicycle under a row of flame trees casting cool shade.
refined_prompt: A schoolgirl in a white ao dai walks her bicycle under a row of flame trees casting cool shade. In Hanoi’s Old Quarter near Hoàn Kiếm Lake, a schoolgirl in a bright yellow ao dai pedals her gleaming black bicycle with ease, symbolizing modern convenience. Her bicycle features a colorful flower-decorated basket adorned with intricate Vietnamese motifs like dragons and lotus flowers, representing strength and purity. Nearby, flame trees are in full bloom, their vibrant red blossoms casting a fiery glow across the streets, marking the beginning of the exams and graduation season in Vietnam. A traditional Vietnamese bamboo bridge spans a small stream, its rustic wooden planks creaking under the weight of a passing villager carrying a large basket of goods, a testament to ancient craftsmanship. This juxtaposition captures the unique cultural identity of Hanoi, where progress and heritage coexist in harmony, symbolizing the city’s resilience and adaptability.
